label: D1 after a reward, when the agent is about to choose a2 (weak a2 preference)
explanation: Fires only at D1, only when the reward input is 1, and almost only (99.9% of mass) when the upcoming GO choice is a2. The upcoming choice is the agent own computed choice, not a random outcome. These are necessary conditions, but the unit fires on only about 9% of such steps (dev P 0.09, R 1.00), so it is a sparse subset. The closest predicate using only observed variables, previous action a2 (P 0.09, R 0.83), is worse. Every activation falls in a narrow band of the D1 policy logit (choice in about -4.4 to -1.5, a mild a2 preference) and a mid band of value (7.1 to 7.7), and it is most common in the middle of the episode (trials 20-70, none after trial 90). Rate is roughly 2x higher, and activations are larger, when the rewarded previous trial was a rare a2->S1 transition: the top quartile is 75% prev_common==0, and the rare-rewarded a2 subset has P 0.27, R 0.38, mass 0.55. Never fires at GO or D2, after no reward, or before a1. It looks like a fine-grained readout of a moderate a2 lean after reward rather than a clean discrete condition.
